summary: Independently validated the Universal Shift & Risk Engine end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_job_shifts_engine.py covering admin GET/PUT job-shifts (schema + non-admin 401/403 + empty-list/duplicate-id/bad-duration/bad-window 400s + valid save→GET-verify persistence + restore), player POST /jobs/work with shift_id (invalid→400 'Invalid shift option', closed-window→400 'can only start between HH:00 and HH:00', open-window→200 activity created), and legacy hours path (invalid hours→400, valid duration→200, no window enforcement). Both guard scripts (verify_economy.py + verify_markets.py) still print ALL ... PASSED. Frontend: Admin ▸ Gameplay Tuning ▸ Job Shifts grid renders with jobshift-job-cleaner + all 3 shift pills; edit modal (jobshifts-editor) exposes every field/action testid listed in the request. Player Current Job page correctly gates by live game clock (game hour = 23): morning and day shifts render 'Opens HH:00–HH:00 · now 23:00' with NO start button, night shift shows the green START NIGHT SANITATION button, ×1.4 PAY / ×1.15 XP / HIGH RISK pills; clicking Start clocks in and In-Progress panel shows 'Cleaner — Night Sanitation 5h 59m 57s'. critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py PUT /admin/job-shifts validates window hours as 0..24 (inclusive of 24). shift_window_open() clamps hi as int and uses lo<=h<hi so hi=24 works, but hi=0 with lo=0 yields lo==hi -> 'always open' (returns True) which likely isn't the intended semantics for a zero-length window; consider requiring hi != lo or documenting the 'lo==hi means 24h open' behaviour.

routes/player.py work_shift error string mixes 'and' with 24-hour times formatted %02d:00. For overnight wraps (min>max) the message reads 'can only start between 21:00 and 03:00' which is grammatically correct but doesn't hint at midnight wrap; UX could add '(overnight)' suffix for wrapped windows.

seed_data JOB_SHIFTS assigns Night Loading a start_window of 22→5 with duration 8h; a shift starting at 05:00 (last legal minute) would run to 13:00 – fine, but if start_window max is exclusive (05 not allowed) tests should be aware. Current shift_window_open uses lo<=h<hi so hour==22..04 legal, hour 5 illegal — consistent.

Legacy hours-path in work_shift silently bypasses time-window enforcement. This is intentional (backward compat) but could allow scripted/API clients to skirt the whole gating system. Consider logging or a soft-warning event so admins can spot abuse.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin panel + player shift cards + start flow)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_job_shifts_engine.py. Run with 'pytest backend/tests/test_job_shifts_engine.py -o addopts= -v' (rootdir pytest.ini enables xdist parallelism which races on the shared cleaner job — pass -o addopts= to force serial). Player tests auto-cancel any pending activity via POST /api/game/cancel-activity so they're re-runnable. Window openness depends on the LIVE game clock (1 real hour = 1 game hour) — DO NOT hardcode an expected 'open shift'; compute it from GET /api/config game_time hour. When testing UI on Current Job, at game hour 23 only 'night' is open; other hours will flip which cards show Start vs 'Opens …'. jobshifts-cancel testid is present for closing the editor without saving.
